topics.topic: Exact untested owner-device, kernel-integration, and VPS deployment boundaries and dependent behavior
questions: What does “the kernel” mean here, given that running and accessing Syncthing instances ordinarily uses an operating-system kernel: no kernel at all, no product kernel integration, or no target production kernel?
What exact devices, component called “the kernel,” and VPS deployment are excluded, and which promised actions or interfaces depend on each?
Which owner devices, operating systems, filesystem semantics and Syncthing configurations remain untested?
What specific kernel or kernel-facing integration is meant, and which primary-action behavior depends on it?
Which VPS, deployed components, configuration and trust boundaries are meant, and what behavior remains unverified there?

topics.topic: Ownership, access, hosting, and trust boundary of the private Syncthing instances

Who controlled and could access these instances, and did they represent separate device or user trust boundaries?
What makes an instance private, who controls and can access it, and does its trust boundary match the product's intended Syncthing environment?
